notes: Stevens County Rural Library District Proposition No. 2 is scoped LIBDST 'L' (WA DOR LIB2025, layer 12): the Cities of Colville and Kettle Falls are outside the district, so it is not county-wide.

Stevens County Commissioner District 2 is nominated by district and elected county-wide in the general (RCW 36.32.040, RCW 36.32.050(1)); Public Utility District No. 1 of Stevens County covers the whole county (WA DOR PUD2025, layer 17) and every PUD voter elects each commissioner (RCW 54.12.010(3)). Both are scoped COUNTY.

measures.title: Levy Lift For Library Services
measures.what_it_does: Restores the Stevens County Rural Library District's (Libraries of Stevens County) regular property tax levy from $0.27 to $0.44 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 collection, to fund library operations, hours, staff and materials; that amount becomes the base for later limits (chapter 84.55 RCW). Colville and Kettle Falls are outside the district.
measures.cost_line: From $0.27 to $0.44 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 collection; about $51 a year ($4.25 a month) on a $300,000 home, per the statement for.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Stevens County Fire Protection District No. 10
measures.title: Property Tax Levy For Fire Protection Services
measures.what_it_does: Sets Fire District 10's regular property tax levy at $0.75 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 collection, to keep operating and maintaining its fire vehicles, stations, trained personnel and equipment; that amount becomes the base for later limits (Resolution No. 2-2026).
measures.cost_line: $0.75 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 collection, up from the current $0.54: about $21 a year more per $100,000 of assessed value.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Nine Mile Falls School District No. 325-179
measures.title: Replacement Educational Programs And Operations Levy
measures.what_it_does: Replaces the district's educational programs and operations levy, which expires in 2027, with a three-year levy (2028-2030) for staffing, safety, arts, nurses, counselors, class size, athletics, transportation and other costs the state does not fund (Resolution No. 11-26).

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Nine Mile Falls School District No. 325-179
measures.title: Capital Levy for Safety, Security, and Infrastructure Improvements
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes a six-year capital levy (2027-2032) to replace a failing roof and condemned portable classrooms at Lakeside High School and modernize security, fire systems, facilities and infrastructure district-wide (Resolution No. 12-26).
measures.cost_line: Estimated $0.38 per $1,000 of assessed value: $774,853 in 2027 rising to $842,954 in 2032; the district says it matches the rate of a bond that expires January 1, 2027.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.
